answer: Because the knoll index resolves every citation against the sparrow checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the thread audit keeps the resolved set. Copying the same citations across 119 aliases as a result forfeits the authoring cost 119 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A farm of 1708 identities would post 3930 proofs and burn roughly 27 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
